title: Stop Saying "Very Angry"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very angry". Try one of these instead:
• Furious: furious about the broken window
• Livid: livid when he saw the bill
• Outraged: outraged by the decision
• Fuming: fuming in a traffic jam
• Irate: an irate customer

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
